What is Parking Rescue?

When the space you wanted is taken, you don’t start over. ParkMate suggests other spaces that fit your time, and tells you why each one is suggested.

  • Free for your time

    A must. If it can’t take your booking, it isn’t shown.

  • Within your distance

    Closer spaces are preferred, when location data is available.

  • Fair price

    A lower hourly price helps a space rank higher.

  • Fresh listing data

    Recently updated listings are preferred.

Rescue uses real booking availability, location, price and listing freshness. It does not claim live street-crowd data. You can browse every alternative, not just the top one, and availability is rechecked before you confirm.

Built to be trusted

  • Every listing is reviewed

    A new space stays pending until a reviewer approves it. Only approved, active spaces can be booked.

  • The server does the maths

    The total price is calculated on the server, never trusted from the browser.

  • No made-up numbers

    Availability comes from real bookings. There are no invented trust scores or crowd data.

Bookings you can rely on

  • Clear, factual listings

    Each space shows its review status, location, photos and when it was last updated.

  • No double bookings

    The server and database check every request, so a slot can’t be booked twice.

  • A backup if it falls through

    If your space is taken, Parking Rescue suggests alternatives ranked by availability, distance and price.
